{{Quote|It's good to know that military intelligence respects CSF.|A Sullustan crime scene officer|<ref name="TripleZero" />}}
A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] '''individual''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At that [[Time/Legends|time]], the Sullustan served as a [[Scenes of Crimes Officer]] for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force's]] [[Forensics Unit]].<ref name="TripleZero" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', including the appearance of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the officer responded along with several other SOCOs and the CSF's [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] to [[Depot Bravo Five]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. The depot was the scene of an [[Depot Bravo Five terrorist attack|attack]] by Separatist [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]. During the investigation, GAR [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] requested the SOCOs process the scene instead of members of his [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]. The [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] was grateful for the confidence the Special Operations Brigade, namely Skirata, placed in the CSF's capabilities.<ref name="TripleZero" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sullustan officer appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="TripleZero" />
